//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Fashion Points / Gold Points
//===== License / provenance =================================
//= Clean-room implementation from the published player-facing rules at:
//= Application and recovery use the dedicated compensated-transaction service
//= in this package. The stock Malangdo tables are intentionally not extended.
//============================================================
//= Published rules implemented here:
//= * 1 Gold Point per 3 minutes online; balance cap 50.
//= * 1 Gold Point exchanges to 1 Fashion Point.
//= * Costume trade: 15 Fashion Points; Bio5/Tomb costume: 1 point.
//= * Listed enchant-stone trade: 10 Fashion Points.
//= * Removing one recoverable stone costs 30 Fashion Points, 10 of
//=   item 50000 (Server Coin), or 1,000,000 Zeny.
//= * Top/Mid/Low/Garment-slot-1 boxes cost 50 points; Garment-slot-2
//=   costs 300 points.
//============================================================
//= Compatibility policy / intentionally unpublished behavior:
//= * rAthena has no "master account" above a login account. #FP_* are
//=   login-account variables, so linked login accounts do not share points.
//= * This repository has mal_in01 but not reference server's main_office/mal_in maps.
//=   The service NPCs are therefore grouped by the stock Malangdo costume
//=   NPCs. This placement is compatibility policy, not a published coordinate.
//= * The wiki publishes box contents but not per-item probabilities. Per the
//=   requested clean-room compatibility policy, each box selects uniformly
//=   from its published outcomes. This is NOT claimed to be reference server's rate table.
//= * PN costume catalogue price: 150 Fashion Points per installed costume.
//=   This is PN project policy, not a reference-server price.
//= * stone_catalogue.json retains the original 366 pairs and adds verified
//=   official regional stones, including cosmetic fourth-slot families.
//=   New visual/Festa boxes cost 50 points and select uniformly.
//=   Normal card/enchant-type validation applies to every output.
//============================================================

// Return whether an enchant has a functional effect on this server build.
// The Druid dependencies are now integrated. Keep the card/enchant-type gate
// so invalid records cannot be awarded or inserted by the service.
function	script	FP_EnchantSupported	{
	.@enchant = getarg(0);
	if (getiteminfo(.@enchant,ITEMINFO_TYPE) != IT_CARD
		|| getiteminfo(.@enchant,ITEMINFO_SUBTYPE) != CARD_ENCHANT)
		return 0;
	return 1;
}

function	script	FP_IsTombCostume	{
	// Stock kRO Bio5 costume versions of Old Headgears.
	.@id = getarg(0);
	return (.@id >= 19961 && .@id <= 19974);
}

function	script	FP_OpenBox	{
	.@box_index=getarg(0);
	.@box_item=getarg(1);
	.@n=callfunc("FP_LoadBox",.@box_index);
	deletearray .@available[0],128;
	.@count=0;
	for (.@i=0; .@i<.@n; ++.@i) {
		// Award only pairs whose stone and enchant records are loaded correctly.
		if (getiteminfo(@FP_BoxStone[.@i],ITEMINFO_TYPE) < 0 || !callfunc("FP_EnchantSupported",@FP_BoxEnchant[.@i])) continue;
		.@available[.@count++]=@FP_BoxStone[.@i];
	}
	if (!.@count) {
		dispbottom "This Fashion box has no supported outcomes. It was not consumed.";
		return 0;
	}
	.@reward=.@available[rand(.@count)];
	if (countitem(.@box_item) < 1 || !checkweight(.@reward,1)) {
		dispbottom "The Fashion box was not consumed. Make room in your inventory and try again.";
		return 0;
	}
	// DelayConsume: verify delivery before consuming the box. No input yields.
	.@before=countitem(.@reward);
	getordinaryitem .@reward,1;
	if (countitem(.@reward)!=.@before+1) return 0;
	delitem .@box_item,1;
	dispbottom "The Fashion box awarded " + getitemname(.@reward) + ". (Uniform compatibility selection.)";
	return 1;
}

// Deliver before charging, with no dialogue yield between the two operations.
// getitem has no script return value; verify the inventory delta explicitly.
function	script	FP_BuyItem	{
	.@item=getarg(0); .@cost=getarg(1);
	if (.@cost<1 || #FP_Fashion<.@cost || getiteminfo(.@item,ITEMINFO_TYPE)<0) return 0;
	if (!checkweight(.@item,1)) return 0;
	.@before=countitem(.@item);
	getitem .@item,1;
	if (countitem(.@item)!=.@before+1) return 0;
	#FP_Fashion-=.@cost;
	return 1;
}

// Accept only plain, permanent records. Re-read the exact row after all input.
function	script	FP_TradeItem	{
	.@idx=getarg(0); .@id=getarg(1); .@amount=getarg(2); .@points=getarg(3);
	if (.@amount<1 || .@points<1 || #FP_Fashion<0
		|| #FP_Fashion>9223372036854775807-.@points) return 0;
	getinventorylist;
	for (.@row=0; .@row<@inventorylist_count; ++.@row) {
		if (@inventorylist_idx[.@row]!=.@idx) continue;
		if (@inventorylist_id[.@row]!=.@id || @inventorylist_amount[.@row]<.@amount
			|| @inventorylist_equip[.@row] || @inventorylist_expire[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_favorite[.@row] || @inventorylist_bound[.@row]
			|| !@inventorylist_identify[.@row] || @inventorylist_attribute[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_refine[.@row] || @inventorylist_enchantgrade[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_card1[.@row] || @inventorylist_card2[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_card3[.@row] || @inventorylist_card4[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_option_id1[.@row] || @inventorylist_option_id2[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_option_id3[.@row] || @inventorylist_option_id4[.@row]
			|| @inventorylist_option_id5[.@row]) return 0;
		if (!delitemidx(.@idx,.@amount)) return 0;
		#FP_Fashion+=.@points;
		return 1;
	}
	return 0;
}

// Account login + online-only Gold Point clock.
-	script	FashionPointClock	FAKE_NPC,{
	end;

OnInit:
	bindatcmd "activity",strnpcinfo(3) + "::OnAtActivity",0,99;
	end;

OnPCLoginEvent:
	if (#FP_Gold >= 50) {
		#FP_Gold = 50;
		dispbottom "Gold Points are capped at 50. Use @goldpoints to visit the exchange desk (1 Gold = 1 Fashion Point).";
		dispbottom "@goldpoints takes you to the Gold Point Manager. @fashion takes you to the fashion services. Click an NPC to use its service.";
		@FP_TimerRunning = 0;
		goldpointinfo;
		end;
	}
	@FP_TimerRunning = 1;
	@FP_GoldNextAt = gettimetick(2) + 180;
	addtimer 180000,strnpcinfo(3) + "::OnGoldTick";
	goldpointinfo;
	end;

OnGoldTick:
	@FP_TimerRunning = 0;
	if (#FP_Gold < 50) ++#FP_Gold;
	if (#FP_Gold >= 50) {
		#FP_Gold = 50;
		goldpointinfo;
		dispbottom "Gold Points reached 50. Use @goldpoints to exchange them for Fashion Points and resume earning.";
		dispbottom "@goldpoints takes you to the Gold Point Manager. @fashion takes you to the fashion services. Click an NPC to use its service.";
		end;
	}
	@FP_TimerRunning = 1;
	@FP_GoldNextAt = gettimetick(2) + 180;
	addtimer 180000,strnpcinfo(3) + "::OnGoldTick";
	goldpointinfo;
	end;

OnAtActivity:
	dispbottom "Gold Points: " + #FP_Gold + "/50 | Fashion Points: " + #FP_Fashion;
	dispbottom "Earn 1 Gold Point every 3 minutes online. @goldpoints takes you to the Gold Point Manager (exchange 1 for 1).";
	dispbottom "@fashion opens access to the Designer (trade-ins), Catalogue (150 FP costumes), Boxes, Enchanter and Recycler. Click the NPC when you arrive.";
	end;
}

// Compatibility placement beside stock Designer Heidam.
mal_in01,24,123,4	script	Gold Point Manager#FP	4_M_MAYOR,{
	mes "[Gold Point Manager]";
	mes "Gold Points: ^0000ff" + #FP_Gold + "^000000";
	mes "Fashion Points: ^0000ff" + #FP_Fashion + "^000000";
	mes "What do you want to do?";
	.@choice=select("Convert Gold Points to Fashion Points:Exchange style consumables (1 point each):View balances:Cancel");
	if (.@choice == 4) close;
	if (.@choice == 3) {
		next;
		mes "[Gold Point Manager]";
		mes "Gold Points: ^0000ff" + #FP_Gold + "/50^000000";
		mes "Fashion Points: ^0000ff" + #FP_Fashion + "^000000";
		mes "Earn 1 Gold Point every 3 minutes online, up to 50.";
		mes "Points belong to your login account. Separate login accounts do not share points.";
		close;
	}
	if (.@choice == 2) {
		next;
		mes "[Gold Point Manager]";
		mes "Each dye costs 1 Gold Point.";
		.@dye=select("Scarlet Dyestuffs:Lemon Dyestuffs:Cobaltblue Dyestuffs:Darkgreen Dyestuffs:Orange Dyestuffs:Violet Dyestuffs:White Dyestuffs:Black Dyestuffs:Cancel");
		if (.@dye == 9) close;
		setarray .@items[0],975,976,978,979,980,981,982,983;
		.@item=.@items[.@dye-1];
		mes "Exchange 1 Gold Point for " + getitemname(.@item) + "?";
		next;
		if (select("Exchange:Cancel") == 2) close;
		if (#FP_Gold < 1 || !checkweight(.@item,1)) {
			mes "You need 1 Gold Point and enough inventory space.";
			close;
		}
		.@before=countitem(.@item);
		getitem .@item,1;
		if (countitem(.@item) != .@before+1) {
			mes "The item could not be delivered. No points were spent.";
			close;
		}
		--#FP_Gold;
		callsub S_ResumeClock;
		mes "Received " + getitemname(.@item) + ".";
		close;
	}
	next;
	if (#FP_Gold < 1) {
		mes "[Gold Point Manager]";
		mes "You do not have any Gold Points to exchange.";
		close;
	}
	mes "[Gold Point Manager]";
	mes "How many? (1-" + #FP_Gold + ")";
	input .@amount,0,50;
	if (.@amount<1) close;
	mes "Exchange " + .@amount + " Gold Points for the same number of Fashion Points?";
	next;
	if (select("Exchange:Cancel")==2) close;
	if (.@amount>#FP_Gold || #FP_Fashion<0 || #FP_Fashion>9223372036854775807-.@amount) {
		mes "Your balance cannot accept this exchange. Nothing was changed.";
		close;
	}
	#FP_Gold -= .@amount;
	#FP_Fashion += .@amount;
	callsub S_ResumeClock;
	mes "[Gold Point Manager]";
	mes "Exchanged ^0000ff" + .@amount + " Gold Points^000000 for ^0000ff" + .@amount + " Fashion Points^000000.";
	close;

S_ResumeClock:
	if (!@FP_TimerRunning) {
		@FP_TimerRunning = 1;
		@FP_GoldNextAt = gettimetick(2) + 180;
		addtimer 180000,"FashionPointClock::OnGoldTick";
	}
	goldpointinfo;
	return;
}

// Current wiki points to main_office,62,278; this server has no main_office map.
mal_in01,21,123,5	script	Fashion Designer#FP	4_CAT_SAILOR5,{
	mes "[Designer Heidam]";
	mes "Fashion Points: ^cc33cc" + #FP_Fashion + "^000000";
	next;
	switch (select("Trade a costume:Trade enchant stones:Trade rules:Leave")) {
	case 1:
		disable_items;
		getinventorylist;
		.@found = 0;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < @inventorylist_count; ++.@i) {
			.@id = @inventorylist_id[.@i];
			.@loc = getiteminfo(.@id,ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS);
			if (getiteminfo(.@id,ITEMINFO_TYPE) != IT_ARMOR || !(.@loc & (EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP|EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_MID|EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW|EQP_COSTUME_GARMENT))) continue;
			if (@inventorylist_equip[.@i] || @inventorylist_expire[.@i]) continue;
			if (@inventorylist_favorite[.@i] || @inventorylist_bound[.@i] || !@inventorylist_identify[.@i] || @inventorylist_attribute[.@i]) continue;
			if (@inventorylist_option_id1[.@i] || @inventorylist_option_id2[.@i] || @inventorylist_option_id3[.@i] || @inventorylist_option_id4[.@i] || @inventorylist_option_id5[.@i]) continue;
			if (@inventorylist_refine[.@i] || @inventorylist_enchantgrade[.@i] || @inventorylist_card1[.@i] || @inventorylist_card2[.@i] || @inventorylist_card3[.@i] || @inventorylist_card4[.@i]) continue;
			.@found = 1;
			.@points = callfunc("FP_IsTombCostume",.@id) ? 1 : 15;
			mes "[Designer Heidam]";
			mes "Trade ^0000ff" + getitemname(.@id) + "^000000 for ^cc33cc" + .@points + " Fashion Points^000000?";
			next;
			switch (select("Trade it:Skip it:Stop")) {
			case 1:
				if (@inventorylist_id[.@i] != .@id) close;
				if (!callfunc("FP_TradeItem",@inventorylist_idx[.@i],.@id,1,.@points)) {
					mes "The costume could not be removed. No Fashion Points were awarded.";
					close;
				}
				mes "[Designer Heidam]";
				mes "Trade complete. Balance: ^cc33cc" + #FP_Fashion + "^000000.";
				close;
			case 2: break;
			default: close;
			}
		}
		mes "[Designer Heidam]";
		mes .@found ? "No other eligible costume was selected." : "No eligible unequipped, permanent, unenchanted costume was found.";
		close;
	case 2:
		disable_items;
		getinventorylist;
		.@found = 0;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < @inventorylist_count; ++.@i) {
			.@id = @inventorylist_id[.@i];
			if (!callfunc("FP_StoneKnown",.@id)) continue;
			if (@inventorylist_expire[.@i] || @inventorylist_favorite[.@i] || @inventorylist_bound[.@i]) continue;
			.@found = 1;
			mes "[Designer Heidam]";
			mes "Trade ^0000ff" + getitemname(.@id) + "^000000? You have " + @inventorylist_amount[.@i] + ". Each is worth ^cc33cc10 Fashion Points^000000.";
			next;
			switch (select("Trade:Skip:Stop")) {
			case 1:
				.@amount = 1;
				if (@inventorylist_amount[.@i] > 1) {
					mes "[Designer Heidam]";
					mes "How many?";
					input .@amount,0,@inventorylist_amount[.@i];
				}
				if (.@amount<1) close;
				mes "Trade " + .@amount + " stone(s) for " + (10*.@amount) + " Fashion Points?";
				next;
				if (select("Confirm trade:Cancel")==2) close;
				if (!callfunc("FP_TradeItem",@inventorylist_idx[.@i],.@id,.@amount,10*.@amount)) {
					mes "The selected stack changed or is protected. Nothing was exchanged.";
					close;
				}
				mes "[Designer Heidam]";
				mes "Trade complete. Balance: ^cc33cc" + #FP_Fashion + "^000000.";
				close;
			case 2: break;
			default: close;
			}
		}
		mes "[Designer Heidam]";
		mes .@found ? "No other stone was selected." : "No supported enchant stone from the catalogue was found.";
		close;
	case 3:
		mes "[Designer Heidam]";
		mes "Ordinary costume: ^cc33cc15 points^000000.";
		mes "Bio5/Tomb costume IDs 19961-19974: ^cc33cc1 point^000000.";
		mes "Published enchant stone: ^cc33cc10 points^000000.";
		mes "Favorite, bound, equipped, rental, unidentified, damaged, refined, graded, enchanted or random-option items are protected.";
		mes "Use @fashion for the Enchanter, Recycler, Boxes and Costume Catalogue. Costumes cost 150 Fashion Points each.";
		close;
	default:
		close;
	}
}

// Missing stock Gregio NPC is used for the published recovery service.
mal_in01,24,120,4	script	Gregio Grumani#FP	4_M_RUSMAN1,{
	disable_items;
	setarray .@part[0],EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP,EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_MID,EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW,EQI_COSTUME_GARMENT;
	setarray .@mask[0],EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP,EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_MID,EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW,EQP_COSTUME_GARMENT;
	setarray .@part_name$[0],"upper costume","middle costume","lower costume","costume garment";
	.@menu$="";
	.@count=0;
	getinventorylist;
	// Index equipped records once, so a full inventory is not rescanned for
	// every position occupied by the same costume.
	for (.@j=0; .@j<@inventorylist_count; ++.@j) {
		if (!@inventorylist_equip[.@j]) continue;
		for (.@i=0; .@i<4; ++.@i)
			if (@inventorylist_equip[.@j]&.@mask[.@i]) {
				.@inventory_for_part[.@i]=@inventorylist_idx[.@j]+1;
				.@item_for_part[.@i]=@inventorylist_id[.@j];
			}
	}
	for (.@i=0; .@i<4; ++.@i) {
		.@id=getequipid(.@part[.@i]);
		if (.@id<1 || .@id!=.@item_for_part[.@i]) continue;
		// A multi-position costume occupies one inventory record. List it once.
		.@inventory_idx=.@inventory_for_part[.@i]-1;
		if (.@inventory_idx<0 || .@listed[.@inventory_idx]) continue;
		.@listed[.@inventory_idx]=1;
		.@parts[.@count]=.@part[.@i];
		.@masks[.@count]=.@mask[.@i];
		.@names$[.@count]=.@part_name$[.@i];
		.@menu$ += replacestr(getitemname(.@id),":"," -") + ":";
		++.@count;
	}
	mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
	if (!.@count) {
		mes "Equip a costume whose stone you want recovered.";
		close;
	}
	mes "I can remove one recognized enchant and return its stone.";
	next;
	.@pick=select(.@menu$)-1;
	.@part=.@parts[.@pick];
	.@mask=.@masks[.@pick];
	.@equip_id=getequipid(.@part);
	.@locations=getiteminfo(.@equip_id,ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS);
	.@menu$="";
	.@count=0;
	.@slot_limit=4;
	for (.@slot=0; .@slot<.@slot_limit; ++.@slot) {
		if (.@part==EQI_COSTUME_GARMENT && .@slot==2) continue;
		.@enchant=getequipcardid(.@part,.@slot);
		.@category=(.@part==EQI_COSTUME_GARMENT)?(3+.@slot):.@slot;
		if (.@slot==3) {
			// Visuals share card slot four across all supported costume positions.
			// The card ID cannot retain the original material's family. For an
			// ambiguous ID, return the first matching family in canonical order:
			// upper, middle, lower, garment. Unique effects remain recoverable.
			.@stone=0;
			if (.@locations&EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP) .@stone=callfunc("FP_StoneFromEnchant",.@enchant,5);
			if (!.@stone && (.@locations&EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_MID)) .@stone=callfunc("FP_StoneFromEnchant",.@enchant,6);
			if (!.@stone && (.@locations&EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW)) .@stone=callfunc("FP_StoneFromEnchant",.@enchant,7);
			if (!.@stone && (.@locations&EQP_COSTUME_GARMENT)) .@stone=callfunc("FP_StoneFromEnchant",.@enchant,8);
		} else
			// Stat slots identify their own upper/middle/lower family.
			.@stone=callfunc("FP_StoneFromEnchant",.@enchant,.@category);
		// Thai Festa is an upper-costume enchant in displayed slot two.
		// An upper costume may also occupy other equipment positions.
		if (.@slot==1 && (getiteminfo(.@equip_id,ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS)&EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP)) {
			.@festa=callfunc("FP_StoneFromEnchant",.@enchant,9);
			if (.@festa) .@stone=.@festa;
		}
		if (!.@stone || getiteminfo(.@stone,ITEMINFO_TYPE) < 0) continue;
		.@slots[.@count]=.@slot;
		.@stones[.@count]=.@stone;
		.@enchants[.@count]=.@enchant;
		.@menu$ += "Slot " + (.@slot+1) + " - " + replacestr(getitemname(.@enchant),":"," -") + ":";
		++.@count;
	}
	if (!.@count) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "That " + .@names$[.@pick] + " has no recoverable enchant from the supported catalogue.";
		close;
	}
	mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
	mes "Which enchant should I remove?";
	next;
	.@pick=select(.@menu$)-1;
	.@slot=.@slots[.@pick];
	.@stone=.@stones[.@pick];
	.@enchant=.@enchants[.@pick];
	mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
	mes "Recover ^0000ff" + getitemname(.@stone) + "^000000 from slot " + (.@slot+1) + ".";
	mes "Choose the published per-stone payment.";
	next;
	.@coin_ok=(getiteminfo(50000,ITEMINFO_TYPE) >= 0);
	.@pay=select("30 Fashion Points:" + (.@coin_ok ? "10 Server Coins:" : "^77777710 Server Coins (item 50000 unavailable):") + "1,000,000 Zeny:Cancel");
	if (.@pay == 4) close;
	if (.@pay == 1 && #FP_Fashion < 30) { mes "[Gregio Grumani]"; mes "You need 30 Fashion Points."; close; }
	if (.@pay == 2 && (!.@coin_ok || countitem(50000) < 10)) { mes "[Gregio Grumani]"; mes "The Server Coin option is unavailable or you have fewer than 10."; close; }
	if (.@pay == 3 && Zeny < 1000000) { mes "[Gregio Grumani]"; mes "You need 1,000,000 Zeny."; close; }
	mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
	mes "The same costume and unique ID are retained. If the guarded in-place removal fails, the staged stone is removed and your payment is refunded.";
	next;
	if (select("Recover stone:Cancel")==2) close;
	if (getequipid(.@part) != .@equip_id || getequipcardid(.@part,.@slot) != .@enchant) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "The equipped costume changed. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}
	getinventorylist;
	.@idx=-1;
	.@coin_need=(.@pay==2)?10:0;
	.@coin_rows=0;
	for (.@i=0; .@i<@inventorylist_count; ++.@i) {
		if ((@inventorylist_equip[.@i] & .@mask) && @inventorylist_id[.@i] == .@equip_id)
			.@idx=.@i;
		// Snapshot amounts by exact index in this pass, without another scan or
		// per-row branch. Keep expanded-inventory commits below the VM jump cap.
		.@amount_before_at[@inventorylist_idx[.@i]]=@inventorylist_amount[.@i];
		if (.@coin_need>0 && @inventorylist_id[.@i]==50000
			&& @inventorylist_amount[.@i]>0 && !@inventorylist_expire[.@i]
			&& !@inventorylist_favorite[.@i]) {
			.@take=@inventorylist_amount[.@i];
			if (.@take>.@coin_need) .@take=.@coin_need;
			.@coin_idx[.@coin_rows]=@inventorylist_idx[.@i];
			.@coin_bound[.@coin_rows]=@inventorylist_bound[.@i];
			.@coin_take[.@coin_rows]=.@take;
			.@coin_need-=.@take;
			++.@coin_rows;
		}
	}
	if (.@idx < 0) { mes "[Gregio Grumani]"; mes "I could not locate that equipped item safely."; close; }
	if (.@pay==2 && .@coin_need>0) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "You need 10 permanent, non-favorite Server Coins in inventory. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}
	if (!@inventorylist_identify[.@idx] || @inventorylist_amount[.@idx]!=1) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "Only one identified equipped costume can be changed safely. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}
	if (getiteminfo(.@equip_id,ITEMINFO_TYPE) != IT_ARMOR
		|| !(getiteminfo(.@equip_id,ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS)&.@mask)
		|| .@slot < getitemslots(.@equip_id)) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "That position is not a costume-enchant slot, so no card or payment was changed.";
		close;
	}
	setarray .@card[0],@inventorylist_card1[.@idx],@inventorylist_card2[.@idx],@inventorylist_card3[.@idx],@inventorylist_card4[.@idx];
	if (.@card[0]==CARD0_FORGE || .@card[0]==CARD0_CREATE || .@card[0]==CARD0_PET
		|| .@card[.@slot]!=.@enchant) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "This item's card metadata cannot be changed safely. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}
	if (!checkweight(.@stone,1)) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "Make room for the returned stone. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}
	// Recheck the selected payment immediately before staging the returned stone.
	if ((.@pay==1 && #FP_Fashion<30) || (.@pay==2 && countitem(50000)<10)
		|| (.@pay==3 && Zeny<1000000)) {
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "The selected payment changed. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}

	// Stage the one output and identify its exact inventory index. No player
	// input occurs between staging, payment and the guarded mutation.
	getitem .@stone,1;
	getinventorylist;
	.@return_idx=-1;
	for (.@i=0; .@i<@inventorylist_count; ++.@i) {
		.@row_by_idx[@inventorylist_idx[.@i]]=.@i+1;
		if (@inventorylist_id[.@i]==.@stone && !@inventorylist_expire[.@i]
			&& !@inventorylist_bound[.@i]
			&& @inventorylist_amount[.@i]==.@amount_before_at[@inventorylist_idx[.@i]]+1)
			.@return_idx=@inventorylist_idx[.@i];
	}
	.@payment_ok=((.@pay==1 && #FP_Fashion>=30) || (.@pay==3 && Zeny>=1000000));
	if (.@pay==2) {
		.@payment_ok=1;
		for (.@i=0; .@i<.@coin_rows; ++.@i) {
			.@coin_list=.@row_by_idx[.@coin_idx[.@i]]-1;
			if (.@coin_list<0 || @inventorylist_id[.@coin_list]!=50000
				|| @inventorylist_amount[.@coin_list]<.@coin_take[.@i]
				|| @inventorylist_expire[.@coin_list] || @inventorylist_favorite[.@coin_list]
				|| @inventorylist_bound[.@coin_list]!=.@coin_bound[.@i]) {
				.@payment_ok=0;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	if (.@return_idx<0 || getequipid(.@part)!=.@equip_id
		|| getequipcardid(.@part,.@slot)!=.@enchant
		|| !.@payment_ok) {
		if (.@return_idx>=0) delitemidx .@return_idx,1;
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "Final verification failed. The staged stone was removed and nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}

	// Commit the selected payment. Exact Server Coin rows are used so mixed
	// bindings are restored correctly on any later mutation failure.
	if (.@pay==1)
		#FP_Fashion-=30;
	else if (.@pay==2) {
		.@paid_rows=0;
		for (.@i=0; .@i<.@coin_rows; ++.@i) {
			if (!delitemidx(.@coin_idx[.@i],.@coin_take[.@i])) {
				delitemidx .@return_idx,1;
				for (.@j=0; .@j<.@paid_rows; ++.@j) {
					if (.@coin_bound[.@j]) getitembound 50000,.@coin_take[.@j],.@coin_bound[.@j];
					else getitem 50000,.@coin_take[.@j];
				}
				mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
				mes "Server Coin payment could not be committed. The staged stone was removed and deducted coins were refunded.";
				close;
			}
			++.@paid_rows;
		}
	}
	else
		Zeny-=1000000;

	if (!modifyequipitem(.@part,.@equip_id,0,-1,.@slot,.@enchant,0)) {
		delitemidx .@return_idx,1;
		if (.@pay==1) #FP_Fashion += 30;
		else if (.@pay==2) {
			for (.@i=0; .@i<.@coin_rows; ++.@i) {
				if (.@coin_bound[.@i]) getitembound 50000,.@coin_take[.@i],.@coin_bound[.@i];
				else getitem 50000,.@coin_take[.@i];
			}
		}
		else Zeny += 1000000;
		mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
		mes "The equipped item changed or failed a safety check. The staged stone was removed and your payment was refunded.";
		close;
	}
	mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
	mes "The stone was recovered from the same costume and unique ID. Every unrelated item field was preserved.";
	mes "If an equipment restriction prevented automatic re-equipping, the costume is safely in your inventory.";
	close;
}

// Compatibility placement near the stock enchanters. The current wiki's actual
// point-shop coordinate (main_office,62,283) cannot load on this server.
mal_in01,27,120,4	script	Fashion Box Shop#FP	4_F_KAFRA1,{
	setarray .@box[0],41090,41091,41092,41093,41287,41094,41095,41096,41097,41288,41098,41099,41100,41101,41289,41102,41103,41104,41255,41290,41105,41500,41501,41502,41503,41504;
	setarray .@name$[0],"Top Box 1","Top Box 2","Top Box 3","Top Box 4","Top Box 5","Mid Box 1","Mid Box 2","Mid Box 3","Mid Box 4","Mid Box 5","Low Box 1","Low Box 2","Low Box 3","Low Box 4","Low Box 5","Garment Box 1","Garment Box 2","Garment Box 3","Garment Box 4","Garment Box 5","Garment 2nd-slot Box 1","Top Visual Effect Box","Middle Visual Effect Box","Lower Visual Effect Box","Garment Footprint Box","Festa Upper Slot 2 Box";
	mes "[Fashion Box Shop]";
	mes "Fashion Points: ^cc33cc" + #FP_Fashion + "^000000";
	mes "Boxes cost 50 points; the garment second-slot box costs 300 points.";
	mes "Each listed item has an equal chance of being selected.";
	next;
	.@menu$="";
	for (.@i=0; .@i<getarraysize(.@box); ++.@i) .@menu$ += .@name$[.@i] + " - " + ((.@i==20)?300:50) + " FP:";
	.@i=select(.@menu$)-1;
	.@cost=(.@i==20)?300:50;
	if (getiteminfo(.@box[.@i],ITEMINFO_TYPE) < 0) {
		mes "[Fashion Box Shop]";
		mes "This box ID is not installed. Import fashion_points_box_item_db.yml first.";
		close;
	}
	if (#FP_Fashion < .@cost) {
		mes "[Fashion Box Shop]";
		mes "You need " + .@cost + " Fashion Points.";
		close;
	}
	if (!checkweight(.@box[.@i],1)) { mes "[Fashion Box Shop]"; mes "Make room in your inventory."; close; }
	mes "[Fashion Box Shop]";
	mes "Buy ^0000ff" + .@name$[.@i] + "^000000 for ^cc33cc" + .@cost + " Fashion Points^000000?";
	next;
	if (select("Buy:Cancel") == 2) close;
	// Confirmation yields: validate the current balance and selected output again.
	if (#FP_Fashion < .@cost) { mes "You no longer have enough Fashion Points."; close; }
	if (!checkweight(.@box[.@i],1)) { mes "Make room in your inventory before purchasing."; close; }
	if (!callfunc("FP_BuyItem",.@box[.@i],.@cost)) {
		mes "The box could not be delivered. No Fashion Points were charged.";
		close;
	}
	mes "[Fashion Box Shop]";
	mes "Purchase complete. Double-click the box to receive one uniformly selected stone.";
	close;
}

mal_in01,27,123,4	script	Fashion Catalogue#FP	4_BOARD3,{
	// IDs 20596, 420132, 420091 and 410171 lack installed English-client
	// metadata. Do not sell them until their client resources are integrated.
	setarray .@cat$[0],
		"480177,61487,61534,61490,420271,61496,61537,480235",
		"60942,20454,40236,410286,40277,20532,40256,60951,480117,60958",
		"400343,40339,31899,31495,19740,420034,19855,31531,40100,31040",
		"61026,40206,40371,400057,31375,40036,21206,410277,19293,400073,31383",
		"19670,61024,31315,5909,420165,400056,400055,400149,480362,480207",
		"410081,410132,420107,420047,400214,400272,19605,436008,436006,440010";
	mes "[Fashion Catalogue]";
	disable_items;
	mes "PN costume price: ^cc33cc150 Fashion Points^000000 each.";
	mes "Your Fashion Points: " + #FP_Fashion + ". Only installed costumes are offered.";
	next;
	.@cat=select("Collection 1:Collection 2:Collection 3:Collection 4:Collection 5:Collection 6:Leave")-1;
	if (.@cat==6) close;
	explode .@id$,.@cat$[.@cat],",";
	.@menu$="";
	for (.@i=0; .@i<getarraysize(.@id$); ++.@i) {
		.@item=atoi(.@id$[.@i]);
		if (getiteminfo(.@item,ITEMINFO_TYPE)!=IT_ARMOR
			|| !(getiteminfo(.@item,ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS)&(EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP|EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_MID|EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW|EQP_COSTUME_GARMENT))) continue;
		.@items[.@count++]=.@item;
		// Colons in real item names are menu separators; normalize labels only.
		.@menu$+=replacestr(getitemname(.@item),":"," -")+" [150 FP]:";
	}
	if (!.@count) { mes "No costumes from this collection are available yet."; close; }
	.@pick=select(.@menu$+"Cancel")-1;
	if (.@pick>=.@count) close;
	.@item=.@items[.@pick];
	mes "Buy " + getitemname(.@item) + " for 150 Fashion Points?";
	mes "Costume trade-in returns 15 points; purchases are not refundable at their purchase price.";
	next;
	if (select("Buy costume:Cancel")==2) close;
	if (!callfunc("FP_BuyItem",.@item,150)) {
		mes "You need 150 Fashion Points and enough inventory space and weight. Nothing was charged.";
		close;
	}
	mes "Purchase complete. Fashion Points remaining: " + #FP_Fashion + ".";
	close;
}
